Sphinx

ℹ️ This is a personal rehoming notice. This animal is not in the SPCA shelter.

Animal Details

📅 Date Posted May 11, 2026
🐾 Animal Type Dogs
♂ Gender Male
🎂 Age 1 year 3 months
🎨 Colour sable white
🐕 Breed shetland crossbreed
🔬 Microchip Yes
✂️ Sterilised Yes
🎓 Training No

Medical History

No medical history.

Personality

Likes: He love to run and play small ball. Dislikes: He dislikes vacuum, toilet flush sound and sometime human giggleling sound. Quirks: Zoomie and love to catch his tail
Recommend rehome to an adult only household , ideally with an individual who can provide necessary time, care and long term commitment. Also to sent him for behaviour training as this dog tend to show a bit of aggressive and tend to bite. However with proper training for Sphinx who is still very young, he has the potential to develop into well behaved companion.
